pairs.summary: Arid3b and GSC motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 6 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; SW480 colorectal adenocarcinoma (primary); ...). Median lift 1.44x, typical spacing ~51 bp between sites. In 6 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
